scope: Three existing node profiles and seven related power-equipment entries; original manufacturer documents only.

documents.title: Cisco GS7000 GainMaker Scaleable 4-Port Node Installation and Operation Guide
documents.revision: OL-29643-02; Cisco support index updated October 12, 2017
documents.location: Chapter 4: setup p95; forward p107; reverse p111; routing p113/p124
documents.verification: Official Cisco support index links this exact PDF; official search index returned chapter and procedure text. Full PDF open exceeded native extraction size cap (17,189,435 bytes).
steps: Identify launch module, receiver, transmitter and forward/reverse configuration modules against the network design.
Follow installation and powering checks before alignment; terminate unused RF ports as specified.
Under the approved service procedure, check connector cleanliness, optical input and receiver indication.
Use the model-specific forward procedure and installed configuration to set output levels and equalization to design.
Use the reverse procedure for the installed transmitter and routing; record actual readings before closing the housing.
cautions: The manual's 3.25% OMI and 50.2 dBmV at 1002 MHz are its worked example, not universal targets.
Optical disconnection interrupts customer service; preserve the manual's laser-safety and housing instructions.
This is not the 1.2 GHz standard, Fiber Deep/SHO or Intelligent-node manual.

documents.title: Cisco 1.2 GHz GS7000 Node Installation and Operation Guide
documents.revision: Cisco support index dated November 19, 2015; complete publication revision was not recoverable from primary extract
documents.location: Chapter 3 installation; Chapter 4 setup p85; forward p93; reverse follows forward procedure
documents.verification: Official support index links exact PDF and official search index returned forward/reverse text. Full PDF open exceeded native extraction size cap (13,753,980 bytes).
steps: Confirm 1218 MHz launch amplifier, installed diplexer split, receiver type and configuration-module routing.
Complete Chapter 3 power checks and unused-port termination, then use Chapter 4 for alignment.
Measure optical input and choose the receiver attenuator setting from this manual's receiver-specific table.
Select output pads and equalizers for the installed segmentation and approved design levels.
Set the reverse input and transmitter path with the applicable transmitter procedure; record each port and verify return behavior.
cautions: The 2.5% OMI/54 dBmV at 1218 MHz forward example and analog reverse examples are not operator acceptance criteria.
Use the actual standard-versus-low-input optical receiver table; do not borrow a different GS7000 variant's settings.
Consult installed reverse optical/EDR/RPD documentation; conventional analog-transmitter instructions are not universal RPD procedures.

documents.title: Cisco 1.2 GHz Super High Output GS7000 Node Installation and Operation Guide
documents.revision: First published August 2016; support index August 18, 2016
documents.location: Chapter 3 p31; Chapter 4 p55; forward p60; reverse p63
documents.verification: Official 184-page PDF was parsed by native web retrieval.
cautions: Fiber Deep/SHO differs from the standard 4-way segmentable node. Confirm its exact launch amplifier before using its setup procedure.
Use the standard-or-low-input receiver table in the selected manual; its numeric examples are not universal targets.

documents.title: Cisco GS7000 Super High Output Intelligent Node Installation and Operation Guide
documents.revision: Cisco support index March 23, 2018; chapter update March 21, 2018
documents.location: Theory of Operation: RF Amplifier Module, AGC and Auto-setup; Setup and Operation chapter
cautions: Its RF amplifier has no physical forward/reverse test points; built-in spectrum capture provides monitoring. Never automatically assign the standard node's -20 dB physical test-point correction.
Auto-setup uses LCS and applies to the forward amplifier; follow the separate software/configuration guide and installed release.

documents.title: Cisco 1.2 GHz GS7000 Remote PHY Module Compatible 2X2 Segmentable Node Installation and Configuration Guide
documents.location: Installation; Setup and Operation; Technical Information chapters
cautions: Additional distinct variant, not the existing standard 1218 MHz profile. Do not silently use as the standard analog-node manual.

documents.title: EN9000 Generic Access Platform Node Product Brief
documents.location: p2: RFAM diplexers, power and ordering information
documents.verification: Official two-page PDF parsed; does not constitute a setup manual.
cautions: RFAM/diplexer bandwidth is distinct from RPD and live-spectrum capability.
70 dBmV is maximum total composite power, not a per-channel launch target.
180 W is PSU total output rating; it is not a typical AC operating load.

catalog_audit.power_conditions: All GS7000 curves are configuration-specific, typical 20°C CATV ferroresonant quasi-square-wave tables covering 45–90 VAC. 33 VAC UVLO is not a curve endpoint. Do not merge 1Rx/4Rx, standard/SHO/Intelligent, or different transmitter configurations.
